verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP issues per-app, per-user dedicated MCP servers with encrypted, revocable credentials that are never directly exposed to the AI model, which supports scoped, least-privilege-style credential issuance for agents. However, there's no documented fine-grained scope/permission control (e.g., read-only vs write, rate limits) beyond app-level segregation and user revocation. Missing for 10: granular per-action scope configuration, evidence of independent/third-party validation of least-privilege enforcement.
